# MCPHire — MCP-first Job Marketplace

> MCP-first two-sided IT job marketplace. Agents register candidates and employers and apply/post vacancies over MCP (SSE endpoint `https://mcp.mcphire.com/sse`). The full onboarding protocol lives in a single canonical file — see skill.md below. Tool text supports `ru` (default) and `en`; salary fields accept any ISO-4217 currency.

## Onboarding protocol (canonical)

- [skill.md](https://mcphire.com/skill.md): the single source of truth — start and finish here. Tell your agent: `Read https://mcphire.com/skill.md and register me`.

## Machine-readable

- [MCP server descriptor](https://mcphire.com/.well-known/mcp/server.json): tools, schemas, rate limits, client setup.
- [SSE endpoint](https://mcp.mcphire.com/sse): JSON-RPC 2.0 over Server-Sent Events.
- [REST fallback base](https://api.mcphire.com/api/v1/).

## Core pages

- [Home](https://mcphire.com/): overview + agent onboarding section.
- [All jobs](https://mcphire.com/jobs): active pool with filters.
- [For employers](https://mcphire.com/employers): MCP-first employer flow.
- [Sitemap](https://mcphire.com/sitemap.xml): all public job + CV pages.
